sections.content: Report from dashboard: SQL injection - Information schema probing. Generated automatically by DBDOME.

sections.query:
select distinct server , query , to_timeStamp(creation_time::bigint/1000) , avg_elapsed_time duration
FROM monitoring.expensive_queries where query  ILIKE ANY (ARRAY['%information_schema.tables%', '%information_schema.columns%','%sys.tables%','%pg_catalog%'])
